487: /// A [`Service`] that accepts requests based on a [`MethodFilter`] and
488: /// allows chaining additional handlers and services.
489: ///
490: /// # When does `MethodRouter` implement [`Service`]?
491: ///
492: /// Whether or not `MethodRouter` implements [`Service`] depends on the state type it requires.
493: ///
494: /// ```
495: /// use tower::Service;
496: /// use axum::{routing::get, extract::State, body::Body, http::Request};
497: ///
498: /// // this `MethodRouter` doesn't require any state, i.e. the state is `()`,
499: /// let method_router = get(|| async {});
500: /// // and thus it implements `Service`
501: /// assert_service(method_router);
502: ///
503: /// // this requires a `String` and doesn't implement `Service`
504: /// let method_router = get(|_: State<String>| async {});
505: /// // until you provide the `String` with `.with_state(...)`
506: /// let method_router_with_state = method_router.with_state(String::new());
507: /// // and then it implements `Service`
508: /// assert_service(method_router_with_state);
509: ///
510: /// // helper to check that a value implements `Service`
511: /// fn assert_service<S>(service: S)
512: /// where
513: ///     S: Service<Request<Body>>,
514: /// {}
515: /// ```

531: #[derive(Clone, Debug)]
532: pub(crate) enum AllowHeader {
533:     /// No `Allow` header value has been built-up yet. This is the default state
534:     None,
535:     /// Don't set an `Allow` header. This is used when `any` or `any_service` are called.
536:     Skip,
537:     /// The current value of the `Allow` header.
538:     Bytes(BytesMut),
539: }

541: impl AllowHeader {
542:     fn merge(self, other: Self) -> Self {
543:         match (self, other) {
544:             (AllowHeader::Skip, _) | (_, AllowHeader::Skip) => AllowHeader::Skip,
545:             (AllowHeader::None, AllowHeader::None) => AllowHeader::None,
546:             (AllowHeader::None, AllowHeader::Bytes(pick)) => AllowHeader::Bytes(pick),
547:             (AllowHeader::Bytes(pick), AllowHeader::None) => AllowHeader::Bytes(pick),
548:             (AllowHeader::Bytes(mut a), AllowHeader::Bytes(b)) => {
549:                 a.extend_from_slice(b",");
550:                 a.extend_from_slice(&b);
551:                 AllowHeader::Bytes(a)
552:             }
553:         }
554:     }
555: }

991:             name: &str,
992:             first: MethodEndpoint<S, B, E>,
993:             second: MethodEndpoint<S, B, E>,

995:             match (first, second) {

997:                 (pick, MethodEndpoint::None) | (MethodEndpoint::None, pick) => pick,
998:                 _ => {
999:                     if let Some(path) = path {

1002:                         );
1003:                     } else {
1004:                         panic!(
1005:                             "Overlapping method route. Cannot merge two method routes that both \
1006:                              define `{name}`"
1007:                         );
1008:                     }
1009:                 }
1010:             }
1011:         }
1012: 
1013:         self.get = merge_inner(path, "GET", self.get, other.get);
1014:         self.head = merge_inner(path, "HEAD", self.head, other.head);
1015:         self.post = merge_inner(path, "POST", self.post, other.post);
1016:         let extra = self.extra;
1017:         let other_extra = other.extra;
1018:         let [delete, options, patch, put, trace] = extra;
1019:         let [other_delete, other_options, other_patch, other_put, other_trace] = other_extra;
1020:         self.extra = [
1021:             merge_inner(path, "DELETE", delete, other_delete),
1022:             merge_inner(path, "OPTIONS", options, other_options),
1023:             merge_inner(path, "PATCH", patch, other_patch),
1024:             merge_inner(path, "PUT", put, other_put),
1025:             merge_inner(path, "TRACE", trace, other_trace),
1026:         ];
1027: 
1028:         self.fallback = self
1029:             .fallback
1030:             .merge(other.fallback)
1031:             .expect("Cannot merge two `MethodRouter`s that both have a fallback");
1032: 
1033:         self.allow_header = self.allow_header.merge(other.allow_header);
1034: 
1035:         self
